headline:
Cheap on growth,
but earnings dipped
chart_note: 10-day range: $545.83 - $592.85, up 8.6% over the window - now right at the 50-day average ($592.05) but still below the 200-day average ($622.45).
why_today: Up 2.5% today, breaking above the 50-day average for the first time in weeks after a choppy few months since the last earnings dip.
pro_1: PEG of just 0.85 despite 28% revenue growth YoY - historically cheap for a company still growing this fast, analyst sentiment strongly positive (55 of 62 Buy/Strong Buy)
pro_2: RSI at 55 with price back above the 50-day average - momentum turning constructive again
con_1: Quarterly earnings down 13.4% YoY despite the revenue growth - margin pressure likely from continued heavy AI infrastructure spending
con_2: Still below the 200-day average ($622.45) and about 25% off the 52-week high ($788.22) - the medium-term trend hasn't fully turned yet
